question: Where did the Blessed Lord teach this doctrine of unity?
premises: The Blessed Lord himself spoke this teaching.
He spoke it in the glorious Kula mystery.
That text bears a true name gained from the unity of power and the holder of power.
inference: Thus the doctrine is grounded in an authoritative Kula scripture centered on the unity of Śakti and Śaktimat.
uncertainties: The exact title implied by kulaguhkare is not fully explicit; it is rendered descriptively.
plain_english: The Blessed Lord himself taught this in the glorious Kula mystery, a text whose true name arises from the unity of power and the holder of power.
